headingTelemetry.coverage: Circular statistics, disabled/default/invalid/sequence config, generic and Choice adapters, real Swarm lifecycle, per-rig onset/no reset, repeat trial, PUB/SUB tracking and telemetry, raw units, player errors and HUD; schema 2 signed degree conversion, DC compensation rate, degree-squared flight threshold, legacy default topic migration

historicalKinefly.comparison: Exact Vector3 and Quaternion component equality on every simulated frame

externalSubscriber.evidence: Retained earlier schema 1 subscriber test; current schema 2 framing and delivery were verified by the real NetMQ subscriber in the Unity suite.

visualValidation: Final graphical flight dashboard inspected at 1600x900: signed DC degrees, yaw and compensation in degrees/second, per-rig change history, flight/bypass and all four rigs visible.
limitations: Physical tracker latency, LED timing, multi-monitor mapping and a packaged standalone player were not bench-tested.
UnityEditor.Search.SearchDatabase emitted its existing indexing exception; recorded separately by the walking suite.
